ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when this HKTM production completeness document was ingested (UTC), used as partition field

reportName.description: Name of the source mission plan report from which the HKTM downlink was consolidated

reportFolder.description: Folder of the source mission plan report

satellite_unit.description: Satellite unit performing the HKTM downlink (e.g. S1A, S2B)

mission.description: Mission the HKTM downlink belongs to (e.g. S1, S2)

datatake_id.description: Identifier of the datatake associated with the HKTM downlink

effective_downlink_start.description: Effective start of the HKTM downlink, used as reference time to correlate produced HKTM products (UTC)

effective_downlink_stop.description: Effective end of the HKTM downlink (UTC)

downlink_start.description: Planned start of the HKTM downlink (UTC)

downlink_stop.description: Planned end of the HKTM downlink (UTC)

downlink_duration.description: Duration of the HKTM downlink in microseconds

station.description: Ground station performing the HKTM downlink

downlink_absolute_orbit.description: Absolute orbit number during which the HKTM downlink occurred

absolute_orbit.description: Absolute orbit number associated with the HKTM sensing

partial.description: Flag indicating whether the HKTM downlink is partial

interface_name.description: Name of the interface that provided the source report

acquisition_start.description: Start of the HKTM acquisition window (UTC)

acquisition_stop.description: End of the HKTM acquisition window (UTC)

acquisition_duration.description: Duration of the HKTM acquisition in microseconds

number_of_scenes.description: Number of scenes associated with the HKTM downlink

completeness.description: HKTM production completeness indicator: 1 if the expected HKTM product was produced, 0 otherwise

downlink_execution_time.description: Execution time of the HKTM downlink (UTC)

related_document_id.description: Identifier of the produced HKTM product proving completeness

related_document_name.description: Name of the produced HKTM product proving completeness

fos_pushing_date_backup.description: FOS backup pushing date of the related HKTM product (UTC)

fos_pushing_date_nominal.description: FOS nominal pushing date of the related HKTM product (UTC)
